name: recorder
description: Record and replay ThousandEyes browser transactions.

scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @te/recorder-ui && npm run build --workspace recorder-extension
scripts.check: npm run format:check && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run build && npm run smoke
scripts.generate:aria: npm run generate:aria --workspace @te/aria && npm run generate:injected-runtime --workspace @te/recorder-runtime
